# Saturday training without a projector

Compliance training filled most of the workshop morning. The slides explained liability but nobody practised greeting a visitor who doesn't read English. Jo improvised a demonstration after lunch and the room became less tense. Could the first ten minutes be someone arriving with a broken lamp? Put that in [[Volunteer handbook]] before we forget which parts of the formal session people actually used.
